predecessor.key_findings: frozen/limited4 worse than full_control (does not support full-schedule forgetting as dominant); marginal improved raw micro AUPRC (+0.004383) and recall@P0.8 (+0.013426) but micro/macro pair-F1 fell (-0.001387/-0.003763) and macro stem-F1 fell (-0.008257), failing the pair-F1 non-inferiority gate (5/9).
predecessor.next_hypothesis: representation or structure-head modification, not optimization schedule; this contract probes whether the limitation is pair-representation WIDTH or structure-head CAPACITY before any change of architectural FORM.

research_question: Holding backbone adaptation, objective, schedule, data, initialization seed, decoder and metrics fixed, is the dominant RAW_SCORE false-negative residue limited by the pair-representation width (d_z) or by the structure-head 2D-scorer capacity (depth/width), and does joint capacity scaling lift decoded pair-F1 above the matched control?

scientific_boundary.capacity_probe_only: Scaling the width of the existing PairRepresentation (d_z) and the depth/width of the existing ResNet2DScorer (n_blocks, hidden). No new module type, no decoder change, no objective change. This respects new_general_modules_allowed=false because no new general module is introduced.

training.compute_policy_note: Uniform exact per-block gradient checkpointing of the ResNet2D scorer across all four arms (memory optimization only). Mathematically equivalent: outputs/gradients unchanged and the trainer restores BatchNorm running stats to the post-forward snapshot after backward, so BN updates once per step. Worst-case L=500/B=4/terminal-20 reserved memory measured at 15072 MiB (repr_head), fitting the 32GB RTX 5090 with AdamW states. Does not alter any scientific variable.

objective.note: Objective identical to full_control (NLL only). The structured marginal objective is deliberately OFF so that any cross-arm difference is attributable to architecture, not to the objective.

initialization_policy.encoder: load_state_dict(shared_init[model][encoder], strict=True) for every arm; the pretrained backbone initialization is identical across arms.
initialization_policy.head: Freshly constructed under torch.manual_seed(seed) for every arm; shared_init[model][head] is NOT loaded (head-init=fresh). The head architecture is the manipulated variable, so its tensors are arm-specific and seeded identically.
initialization_policy.rationale: Loading the shared head with strict=True is impossible for arms whose d_z/blocks/hidden differ. A uniform fresh-head-init policy across all arms (including the matched control) removes any initialization confound: arms differ only in head/representation architecture.
initialization_policy.control_sanity: control_matched uses the default architecture (d_z=128, blocks=4, hidden=64). Its decoded metrics are compared against the reused full_control reference (micro_pair_f1=0.827895) as an integrity sanity check, NOT as a promotion gate; a large divergence flags initialization sensitivity and is reported.

control_matched.purpose: Matched progressive-full-parameter control under the identical fresh-head-init policy; the gate baseline.

repr_wide.purpose: Pair-representation WIDTH probe: widen z_ij from 128 to 256 channels with the head unchanged; tests whether the pair feature bottleneck limits raw-score quality.

head_deep.purpose: Structure-head CAPACITY probe: deepen/widen the ResNet2D scorer (4->8 blocks, 64->128 hidden) with the representation unchanged; tests whether the 2D decision-boundary capacity limits raw-score quality.

repr_head.purpose: Joint capacity / ceiling probe: widen representation AND deepen/widen head together; tests interaction and whether joint capacity lifts decoded pair-F1.

pilot.completion_gate: all four arms completed at step_cap=9600 with terminal unfreeze 20/33 and finite losses/gradient norms; control_matched is the gate baseline.
pilot.promotion_rule: independently verified arms passing every per-arm direction gate vs control_matched may add seeds 1 and 2; failing arms stop

interpretation.repr_wide_better: supports pair-representation width as a contributor to the raw-score limitation; does not prove exclusive causality
interpretation.head_deep_better: supports structure-head 2D-scorer capacity as a contributor; does not prove exclusive causality
interpretation.repr_head_better_than_either_single: supports a joint capacity bottleneck / positive interaction between representation width and head capacity
interpretation.all_fail: capacity scaling of the existing components is insufficient; the FORM of the pair representation or structure head (not its width/depth) becomes the next hypothesis rather than a proven cause; no threshold/decoder/module rescue is attempted
interpretation.control_matched_diverges_from_full_contr: flags initialization sensitivity of the fresh-head-init policy; reported as an integrity finding, not a promotion gate
